data.title: Unitree H2-X Humanoid Robot Loses Leg During Side Flip
data.description: Unitree's H2-X humanoid robot fell and lost a lower leg during a kung fu side-flip demo at the 2026 World Physical AI Conference in Hangzhou on October 24.
